title: Step 68-F Media upload review product attachment order and 3D administration
description: Implement the HIGH-risk Admin Media workspaces on canonical Step 68-E. Cover only source-proven AD-C-04 and AD-C-07 authority: media upload-request/transfer/complete/detail/approve/reject/delete plus Product media read/attach/detach/reorder/primary/alt-text, including the governed GLB model_3d capability introduced in Step 68-B. Preserve server-owned authorization, no media-library invention, no scan-certification claim, no signed-upload URL rendering/logging, fail-closed unknown mutation outcomes, same-product Variant binding, active-media attachment, one-primary invariant and Persian RTL accessibility. A bounded reliability repair may replace inherited fixed browser-acceptance test ports with dynamically allocated/non-ephemeral ports; it must not alter product/runtime behavior.

dependencies.evidence: PR #365 merged after exact-artifact Project Owner approval; exact-SHA Canonical CI #1958, Phase A #1457, CodeQL #1109 and Storefront Quality #934 rerun succeeded; terminal Lock release comment 6231729776.

reliability_repair.observed_incident: Storefront Quality #934 first attempt failed on exact Step 68-E merge SHA with EADDRINUSE 127.0.0.1:41772; rerun passed with no source mutation.
reliability_repair.authorized_change: Use operating-system assigned mock API port and a non-ephemeral admin application port or equivalent deterministic collision-safe binding.

acceptance_criteria.description: Media operations use only canonical generated Admin endpoints through the existing server-owned auth bridge; no parallel credential authority, browser auth storage or invented media-list endpoint is introduced.

Upload accepts only the canonical image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, video/mp4 and model/gltf-binary types, enforces the 50 MiB bound, purpose/MIME compatibility, SHA-256 metadata and GLB extension for product_model_3d.

The signed upload target is treated as ephemeral capability material: it is never rendered as visible text, persisted in browser storage or logged. Transfer and complete are explicit separate states and ambiguous unsafe outcomes are never blindly replayed.

Media review supports only source-proven detail, complete, approve, reject and delete transitions. The UI does not claim virus-scan certification or invent a generic approval queue; referenced assets cannot be deleted.

Product media attachment reads canonical media, attaches only active compatible assets, binds any Variant to the route Product, supports Persian alt text and model_3d, and does not expose model_3d through public Storefront Product Detail.

Reorder sends only already-attached unique media IDs with non-negative integer positions, permits at most one primary media, preserves explicit move controls and restores/announces focus after changes.
Detach removes only the Product-media relationship and is presented distinctly from destructive asset deletion; delete requires explicit review/confirmation and server authority.

All Admin media form mutations enforce trusted same-origin submission, bounded identifiers/form fields and neutral fail-closed 401/403/404/409/422/unknown-outcome handling with request-id evidence where available.

AD-C-04 and AD-C-07 are Persian RTL, responsive and keyboard-accessible. No page horizontal overflow, controls meet inherited 44px target requirements, long Persian text wraps and outcome/revalidation focus is deterministic.

The inherited Step67 integrated browser-acceptance mock/API ports are made collision-safe after the exact-SHA EADDRINUSE incident, without changing application behavior, contracts or production network configuration.

No Sales-Control preview/apply, pricing/inventory/Excel work, Backend/OpenAPI/generated contract/database change, Storefront runtime change, Product Design semantic mutation or Current-State/Master-Roadmap closure reconciliation is introduced.

Canonical closure requires exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A and CodeQL, deterministic Review, Independent Security PASS, exact-artifact ACTIVE Lock and explicit Project Owner Human Gate approval, followed by protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Step 68-F is HIGH risk. Project Owner Human Gate is mandatory only on the final exact HEAD and Artifact after CI, deterministic Review, Independent Security and exact-artifact Lock are complete. Step 68-G remains blocked until terminal canonical closure.
